async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the 'Filters' button to open filter options
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Filters").click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for filter panel to appear
    # Find the input for 'Quantity' filter; use get_by_role with name containing 'Quantity'
    quantity_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Quantity")
    if await quantity_input.count() > 0:
        await quantity_input.fill("3")
    else:
        # If not found, try get_by_placeholder
        quantity_input_alt = page.get_by_placeholder("Quantity")
        if await quantity_input_alt.count() > 0:
            await quantity_input_alt.fill("3")
        else:
            # Fallback: use the search box if filter isn't straightforward
            await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search by keyword").fill("3")
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Apply the filter if there's an apply button
    apply_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply Filters")
    if await apply_button.count() > 0:
        await apply_button.click()
    else:
        # If no apply button, assume filter is applied automatically
        pass
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for results to load
    # Extract product names from the table
    rows = page.get_by_role("rowgroup").nth(1).get_by_role("row")  # Second rowgroup contains data rows
    if await rows.count() == 0 or (await rows.count() == 1 and "We couldn't find any records." in await rows.first().text_content()):
        print("No products found with 3 units left.")
    else:
        product_names = []
        for i in range(await rows.count()):
            row = rows.nth(i)
            row_text = await row.text_content()
            if "We couldn't find any records" in row_text:
                continue
            # Extract the 'Name' column (4th cell based on tree: Options, ID, Thumbnail, Name)
            name_cell = row.get_by_role("cell").nth(3)  # Zero-indexed, so 3 is the fourth cell
            if await name_cell.count() > 0:
                name = await name_cell.text_content()
                product_names.append(name.strip())
        # Print the product names as the result
        print(product_names)
